skillproofdev-seo-translator-root.description: Use when the user asks to translate or localize content — documents, blog posts, marketing copy, website pages, UI strings — into one or more languages, or requests SEO-aware translation for international markets. Handles single texts and batches; detects SEO intent (titles, meta descriptions, keywords) automatically and preserves search-optimized phrasing per target market. Do not trigger for programming-language "translation" or for interpreting spoken conversation.
